locations.label: Upper Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Open the upper Cell Block route to Pack-a-Punch; its access door costs 2,000 and the upgrade costs 5,000. Double Tap is nearby. There is no plane flight, bridge trip or power-meter task. Crouch while using the machine to make it harder for opponents to push you off the walkway. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Double Tap by Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Double Tap is by Pack-a-Punch, Speed Cola in Warden’s Office, Deadshot in Cafeteria, and PhD Flopper plus Mule Kick in the original Mob spawn room. Jugger-Nog, Quick Revive and Electric Cherry are absent. Double Tap and Speed Cola support a wall-gun setup; PhD supports explosive weapons and safe drops. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
